subject.summary: Photo-relative reconstruction of the reddish mansard-roofed neighbor immediately left of the sage-green curved gable in Ximonic's December 2022 Stortorget photograph. No address or historic name is asserted. Faded russet plaster, pale wedge lintels, pink ornamental attic band, charcoal broken-pitch roof and paired dormers are represented by native architectural relief; the hologram does not reproduce plaster paint colors.
